info.title: OjaBook API
info.description: Versioned contract for the OjaBook web app. Money is integer kobo. Quantities are decimal strings. Financial mutations require an Idempotency-Key header. Tenant routes require X-Business-Id.

business.name: X-Business-Id
business.description: The active business. Membership is verified on every request.

phone.description: Nigerian mobile number in any common format.

token.description: Shown once. Share it with the invited person. It is stored only as a hash.

reason.description: Required when changing role, status or permissions.

unitId.description: A product unit conversion. Omit for the base unit.

unitCostKobo.description: Cost of ONE of the chosen unit, in kobo.

quantity.description: Quantity in the product base unit.

note.description: Required. Explains the adjustment in the audit trail.

avgCostKobo.description: Weighted average cost per base unit (kobo). Needs cost.read.

stockValueKobo.description: Quantity x average cost, in kobo. Needs cost.read.

factor.description: How many base units one of this unit contains.

sellingPriceKobo.description: Optional selling price (kobo) for one of this unit.

unitCostKobo.description: Cost per base unit in kobo.

id.description: Client generated UUID, so a retry cannot create a duplicate.

baseUnit.description: The unit stock is counted in.

sellingPriceKobo.description: Selling price per base unit, in kobo.

factor.description: How many base units one of this unit contains.

sellingPriceKobo.description: Optional selling price (kobo) for one of this unit.

quantity.description: Quantity in the chosen unit, a decimal string.

unitId.description: Unit conversion id. Omit for the base unit.

unitPriceKobo.description: Price per unit in kobo. Differing from the list price needs sales.price_override.

discountKobo.description: Discount on this line in kobo. Needs sales.discount.

overrideReason.description: Optional reason for a discount or override.

amountKobo.description: Kobo. All payments must add up to the sale total.

id.description: Client generated UUID. Offline sales keep the same id when they sync.

occurredAt.description: When the sale happened. Defaults to now. Offline sales send their original time.

customerId.description: Required for credit. Walk in sales leave it out.

dueDate.description: Due date for the credit part.

verified.description: True only when the money is verified as settled. Transfers entered by hand are not.

outstandingKobo.description: Unpaid credit sales as of now.

overdueKobo.description: The part of outstanding that is past its due date.

id.description: Client generated UUID so offline creation is retry safe.

balanceKobo.description: Running balance after this row. Pending transfers do not change it.

amountKobo.description: Kobo. Cannot be more than the amount owed.

method.description: A transfer stays unverified and does not reduce the balance until it is verified.

totalPostedKobo.description: Sum of POSTED expenses matching the filter.

id.description: Client generated UUID. Retries and offline sync reuse it.

expenseDate.description: Business local date. Defaults to today.

description.description: Only the description can be edited. Money changes need a reversal and a new expense.

netOperatingProfitKobo.description: Operational figure, not audited statutory profit. Needs reports.financial.

inventoryValueKobo.description: On hand quantity x average cost, now. Needs cost.read.

revenueKobo.description: Net recognised sales in the period, credit sales included, reversals deducted.

collectedKobo.description: Settled cash in the period. Not the same as revenue.

pendingTransfersKobo.description: Transfers entered but not verified. Not counted as collected.

outstandingDebtKobo.description: Unpaid customer credit at the end of the period.

id.description: Client generated operation id. Also the idempotency key, so retries are safe.

payload.description: Same body the matching REST endpoint accepts. For repayment.create also send receivableId or customerId.

clientCreatedAt.description: When the user made it on the device.

result.description: The canonical record the server created, for SYNCED operations.

reason.description: Why. Kept in the audit trail. Dismissing means the local transaction is never recorded.
